controls.name: Full Ephemeral Schema Migration
controls.description: Validates that a dedicated ephemeral schema is created and migrated with complete database tables and seed data, without touching public tables or persistent schemas.

controls.name: Genuine Actor and Auth Provisioning
controls.description: Verifies that all 6 actors have valid database rows in user, profiles, game_interests, session, and valid signed session cookies.

controls.name: Actual Compiled Service Resolution
controls.description: Ensures that the probe resolves and executes the real compiled CallLifecycleService from Build 12 via the NestJS dependency injection container.

controls.name: Background Periodic Sweep Isolation
controls.description: Guarantees that the 1000ms unmetered background sweep timer is stopped during the measurement window so that only explicit concurrent triggers are evaluated.

controls.name: Measured Synthetic Delay Transparency
controls.description: Verifies that the test-only local adapter clearly marks simulated RPC delays (40ms) as synthetic instrumentation rather than native server load, while preserving exact SDK protobuf types.

controls.name: Concurrent Trigger Execution
controls.description: Fires 4 concurrent ordinary reconcile requests against the exact same call group to reproduce overlapping reconciliation pressure.

controls.name: Expected Bounded Work RED Assertion
controls.description: Asserts that total completed reconciliation passes are bounded to at most 2 (1 in-flight + 1 trailing pass). On un-coalesced source, this MUST fail because 4 redundant passes execute sequentially.

controls.name: Actor and Lock Integrity Post-Conditions
controls.description: Verifies that genuine actor and row-locking SQL executed successfully and that call group, room, and member rows remain intact in PostgreSQL.

controls.name: Deterministic Teardown and Cleanup Verification
controls.description: Ensures that all probe resources (ephemeral schema, NestJS app, Redis connection, pg pool) are completely cleaned up in finally, and confirmed in probe-report.json.
assertions: assert(report.poolClosed, 'Database connection pool must end cleanly')
